disable_path: Explicit omnigenis.capabilities.paired_read_alignment.align_paired_fastq invocation and exact execution profile only; no package export, default pipeline activation or automatic resource download. Missing or mismatched resources refuse.
input_fixture: tests/fixtures/paired_read_alignment/valid-r1.fastq and valid-r2.fastq, input-profile.json and fixture-manifest.json. Public artificial reads exercise intake and accounting; full-reference mapping qualification uses independently fixed reference-coordinate oracles.
known_issues: Only the selected cohort is accepted. BWA-MEM2 issue 262 remains unresolved; bounded boundary and supplementary regressions do not imply general accuracy or equivalence to BWA. Coverage, callability, biological identity, variant calling, clinical validity and whole-WGS performance are not assessed.
license: Independent adapter and regenerated synthetic fixtures. External BWA-MEM2 (MIT), samtools/HTSlib (MIT/Expat with retained notices) and htscodecs (BSD with named exceptions) are operator-supplied and not distributed. NCBI reference use retains submitter and third-party rights caveats; this profile grants no redistribution rights. Exact provenance is in the executor profile and scientific resource BOM.
output_contract: schemas/paired-read-alignment-result.v1.schema.json and schemas/artifact-manifest.v1.schema.json; VALID promotes an immutable BAM/BAI pair only after complete physical decoding, reference/header/order/accounting/index checks and strict result reparse. INVALID returns one fixed diagnostic and no artifacts.
real_use_case: Produce a coordinate-sorted BAM and BAI from accepted paired FASTQ bytes with reference, executor, declared identity and complete read-accounting evidence.
resource_budget: CPU affinity restricts native commands to one CPU; BWA-MEM2 mem -t 1 selects one compute thread, while additional pipeline worker threads may run; alignment address space 48 GiB/RSS 32 GiB/900 seconds; sort 8 GiB/4 GiB/600 seconds; decode/index 4 GiB/2 GiB/300 seconds; calling Python process RSS 512 MiB, shared 1800-second deadline, 2 GiB mutable output, 16 MiB per-command stderr, 512 MiB SAM/BAM and 64 MiB BAI. Require at least 40 GiB available host RAM, at least 40 GiB remaining headroom at every applicable finite cgroup memory limit, and 8 GiB free workspace. An inspectable unified cgroup hierarchy is required; inspect memory.max and memory.current at each applicable limit. Exact limits are in the alignment profile.
security: Owned immutable input snapshots, exact complete-content identities, argument-list subprocesses, bounded process groups/deadlines/resources, full BGZF/BAM/BAI validation and atomic promotion. The JSON export excludes read identifiers, operational paths, native command lines and exception text. BAM artifacts retain read identifiers in QNAME fields. Private workspaces may retain sensitive input files and native evidence after success or refusal; the caller is responsible for workspace cleanup.
supported_profile: resources/alignment-profiles/paired-fastq-grch38-p14-bwa-mem2-v1.json; explicit local invocation with the exact complete GRCh38.p14 reference and pinned native/runtime cohort. Resource ceilings are refusal limits, not a whole-WGS support claim.
upstream_status: Pinned BWA-MEM2 release 2.3 (binary display 2.2.1), samtools/HTSlib 1.25, htscodecs 1.6.7, and SAM/BAM 1.6 plus BAI at hts-specs commit b5341fbb5181cc7811c10c741a682149ab0cccf8. See the executor and alignment profiles for exact identities and limitations.
